dek: Taizhou Zhongfu New Materials, a Zhejiang company founded by a former Christmas lights exporter, has cracked the Western monopoly on high-performance deep-sea solid buoyancy materials after a decade of R&D and over 200 million yuan in investment. Its products now hold more than 30% of the domestic market.
